answer:
Here is what I'd raise at your check-up, most important first.

1. Lung nodule follow-up looks overdue. The CT you had for the kidney stone in October 2025 found an incidental 7 mm solid nodule in the lower right lung. The radiologist recommended a chest CT in 6 to 12 months, so by now (about 12 months) it is due or past due. I found no chest CT or other follow-up in your records. You've never smoked, which is reassuring, but the follow-up scan is still advised.

2. Thyroid test not repeated. During your March 2026 hospital stay your TSH was mildly high (7.9) with a normal free T4. The hospital asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6 to 8 weeks. Your June 2026 labs did not include them, and I found no repeat anywhere.

3. Hydrochlorothiazide: does it add up? The hospital stopped it on March 5, 2026 because it caused dangerously low sodium (123). Yet a pharmacy record and the clinic lists still show it as active, and a May 2026 list you reported yourself includes it. Your sodium on June 15 was still slightly low (134). Please confirm with your doctor and pharmacy that you are not taking it, and ask whether the low sodium needs a recheck.

4. Shingles vaccine dose 2. You had the first Shingrix on November 8, 2025. The second dose is due 2 to 6 months later, and I see no record of it.

5. Flu shot. Your last was November 2025, so this season's is due now. No 2026 dose is recorded.

6. Diabetes care. Your A1c has improved (6.9, 6.7, 6.6%) but is still above the usual goal of about 7 or lower only if you're near it. Your eye exam in May 2026 was clear, with the next one due May 2027. I found no urine albumin test (a kidney check recommended yearly in diabetes), no foot exam, and no record of the diabetes education you were referred to.

7. Cholesterol. In September 2025 your LDL was 142 and HDL 48, and you aren't on a cholesterol medicine. At 57 with diabetes, a statin is generally recommended, and the lipids haven't been rechecked. Worth discussing.

8. Kidney stone follow-up. You were told to see your doctor in 1 week and urology if the stone hadn't passed in 2 weeks. I see no record of either, or of whether it passed. Your urine also showed blood then.

9. Cancer screening. Your colonoscopy in 2019 was normal, so the next is due around 2029. I see no mammogram or cervical screening in these records, so check whether they're up to date elsewhere.

10. Record tidy-up. Lisinopril (stopped for cough) still shows as active in an older hospital export, and amlodipine, losartan and metformin appear several times. Your aspirin allergy (hives) and lisinopril cough should stay on file.

The records don't tell me what you're actually taking now or tests done outside these providers, so confirm those with your doctor.
short: Overdue or unclear: follow-up chest CT for a 7 mm lung nodule (Oct 2025), repeat TSH/free T4 after TSH 7.9 (Mar 2026), whether hydrochlorothiazide (stopped for low sodium) is still being taken, Shingrix dose 2, and this season's flu shot; also diabetes urine albumin, statin and kidney stone follow-up.
